text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of a long and<n>arduous
journey in the Twinkle<n>Series for me and my
trainee. Her<n>name is...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrrr! It is I, the Demon Queen! Shinko<n>Windyyy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make each and every<n>racing fan out
there see how cool I<n>am!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll win all the races, and then all the<n>attention'll be
mine, mine, MINE!<n>Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin my days challenging the<n>Twinkle
Series with <chrname>!
